meta.name: general-video
meta.description: Author or edit a custom HyperFrames composition when no specialized workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Use for longer or multi-scene pieces, brand and sizzle reels, montages, static loops, static title cards, footage remixes, and freeform builds. Use motion-graphics instead for a short unnarrated motion-first unit, including an animated title. Route fresh creation through hyperframes before using this skill.

copy.tagline: 创作或编辑自定义视频合成作品
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要制作多场景视频、品牌短片或自由形式的视频合成
copy.tagline_en: Author or edit custom video compositions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to create multi-scene videos, brand reels, or freeform video compositions

howto.what: Claude 会帮你创作或编辑视频项目，包括多场景短片、品牌宣传片、蒙太奇、静态循环、标题卡、素材混剪等。它会先检查项目状态，然后按步骤规划、构建、动画、组装和验证，最后生成预览。
howto.when: 当没有更专门的视频工作流适用，或项目简报（BRIEF.md）指定使用此技能时触发。通常用于较长或多场景的视频创作。

say.text: 帮我做一个30秒的品牌宣传片，展示我们的新产品。
say.note: Claude 会启动视频创作流程，先规划再构建。

say.text: 把这段素材混剪成一个蒙太奇，配上背景音乐。
say.note: Claude 会处理素材、添加音频并组装成视频。

say.text: 修改现有视频项目，把第三场景的动画换成淡入效果。
say.note: Claude 会定位项目并执行指定编辑。

howto.what_en: Claude helps you create or edit video projects, including multi-scene pieces, brand reels, montages, static loops, title cards, and footage remixes. It checks project state, then plans, builds, animates, assembles, and verifies step by step, finally opening a preview.
howto.when_en: Triggered when no specialized video workflow fits, or when BRIEF.md sets flow: companion. Typically used for longer or multi-scene video creation.

say_en.text: Create a 30-second brand reel showcasing our new product.
say_en.note: Claude starts the video creation workflow, planning then building.

say_en.text: Remix this footage into a montage with background music.
say_en.note: Claude processes assets, adds audio, and assembles the video.

say_en.text: Edit the existing video project: change scene 3's animation to a fade-in.
say_en.note: Claude locates the project and applies the specified edit.
